name: HyenaFftSizePaddingRfft
reference:
import torch

def run(x):
    batch, channels, seqlen = x.shape
    fft_size = 2 * seqlen
    x_f32 = x.to(torch.float32)
    x_freq = torch.fft.rfft(x_f32, n=fft_size)
    x_freq = x_freq / fft_size
    return x_freq.real.contiguous(), x_freq.imag.contiguous()
description: FFT size padding + real FFT for Hyena convolution. Computes rfft with n=2*seqlen (circular convolution padding), normalizes by fft_size. Pure PyTorch: torch.fft.rfft with n parameter, return real/imag parts as float32.
